verdict: Ads are spending and converting, but leads aren't reaching your CRM yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,043.35 in Google Ads spend generated 11 conversions recorded on the ad platform — but zero of those leads are showing up in your CRM, which means the demand is real and the gap is a tracking disconnect, not a slow market. Your Google Business Profile drove 25 calls and 57 direction requests this period purely from organic activity, confirming that people are actively looking for your services. Lead capture tracking is being repaired so that every conversion from ads flows correctly into your pipeline. Four milestones — intake ownership, the booking automation test, the financing page, and the Homer Glen branch page — are being advanced now, as they are the gate to scaling spend. Once tracking is confirmed clean and those pages are live, the fall heating campaign launches October 1 with budget ready to increase.
